stories.title: Trump faces backlash after saying he 'convinced' Nvidia to reinstate CEO Jensen Huang
stories.body: Nvidia had come under pressure from President Trump to reappoint Huang, whose comeback helped add $1tn to the company's stock value.

stories.title: US to blacklist Asian AI firm Megaspeed after Nvidia scandal
stories.body: Megaspeed has been accused of funneling AI chips to China after a former executive's affair with Jensen Huang became public.

stories.title: Nato chief vows defence against space threat after Russian nuclear satellite reports
stories.body: German media said Russia planned to launch a satellite with a nuclear warhead into space in coming weeks.

stories.title: What strike on Russian ship in Libya says about spread of Ukraine war
stories.body: Ukraine's sinking of a Russian battleship at a port in Libya raises the stakes of the war a notch, writes Frank Gardner.

stories.title: King Charles and Elton John pay tribute to Australian music legend Molly Meldrum
stories.body: The promoter and broadcaster helped define the music tastes of Australians for decades.

stories.title: Gisèle Pelicot 'humiliated' after nude photos sent to media to promote book
stories.body: The publisher of an essay on coercive control apologises for "an unfortunate and inappropriate communication".

stories.title: Israeli attacks have turned Gaza into 'toxic wasteland', Oxfam says
stories.body: The report says there are signs of possible contamination across almost all of Gaza as a result of Israel's actions.

stories.title: UK sanctions top Myanmar military leaders after Rohingya genocide ruling
stories.body: The UK is joined by several other nations in recognising an ICJ ruling that Myanmar carried out genocide.

stories.title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world
stories.body: Interests of oil-producing countries, a US boycott and a dispute over finance may have torpedoed climate talks.

stories.title: Iranian authorities flog singer who performed without hijab, lawyers say
stories.body: Parastoo Ahmadi, three musicians and a producer were reportedly given 74 lashes in Qom.

stories.title: Comedian impersonates Trump's dance moves, mocks trade talks at Canada press dinner
stories.body: The impersonator, Canadian comedian Mark Critch, poked fun at the US president's search for a new press secretary and US-Canada trade talks.

stories.title: Prominent Zimbabwean preacher arrested on sexual assault allegations
stories.body: Uebert Angel, a British-Zimbabwean national, leads a charismatic church with branches in several countries.

stories.title: How Nvidia is reacting to Jensen Huang's return as CEO
stories.body: BBC's Lily Jamali reports from Nvidia's headquarters, where she gauges the reaction to Huang's return after Trump says he brokered a deal.

stories.title: Outrage after ICE arrest father and daughter at Seattle airport
stories.body: ICE officers arrested two passengers, a father and daughter, as they were boarding a flight in Seattle on Saturday.

stories.title: First Lady Melania Trump welcomes this year's White House Christmas tree
stories.body: The official 2026 White House Christmas tree is an 18-foot fir from Silent Night Evergreens, a farm in Endeavor, Wisconsin.

stories.title: Ukraine shares video of strikes on Russian ships off Libya
stories.body: President Zelensky said a Russia warship was sunk, with a Russian cargo ship also hit.

stories.title: 'Danger seems greater all the time': Ukrainians search for missing after Russian strikes
stories.body: The BBC's Sarah Rainsford reports from the scene of a collapsed residential building in Ukraine's Kyiv region.

stories.title: Dad who discovered daughter's murder on Facebook feels ignored by South African police
stories.body: South African communities tell the BBC of measures they're taking to keep women safe after a wave of horrific killings.

stories.title: 'I want to destroy capitalism, not France': On the streets with the French ultra left
stories.body: The BBC meets the far-left protesters French President Emmanuel Macron says are trying to bring down the Republic.

stories.title: The rise and fall and rise again of Jensen Huang
stories.body: Days after resigning while mired in scandal of extra-marital affairs, Nvidia's Jensen Huang is making a remarkable return.
